* Coordinate with IT and security teams to ensure IAM operations align with security policies, compliance standards, and best practices.
* Mentor junior operations support analysts and contribute to their professional development.

**Education**:



Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  


**Work Requirements:**


* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Director
description:
**About Rubrik**
================


Rubrik is one of the fastest\-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi\-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on\-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We’ve been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup.


Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.


**Job Introduction**
====================


Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket.


We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee’s access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is “My Digital Twin”, an agentic layer carrying an employee’s full context alongside the organization’s memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs.


This is a multi\-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip.


The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global.


**The environment**
===================


A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third\-party SaaS and open source applications.


* Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc.
* Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc.
* VDI and remote desktop environments
* AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production
* ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management)
* Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc.
* Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms
* and others

**What you will be doing**
==========================


**Run the business: operational excellence today**
--------------------------------------------------


* Own the global end\-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones.
* Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all\-hands production.
* Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees.
* Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you.
* Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow\-the\-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites.
* Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office\-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area.
* Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end\-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT\-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits.
* Represent operations in cross\-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy \& Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps.

**Change the business: build toward ticketless**
------------------------------------------------


* Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi\-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site.
* Re\-architect hire\-to\-retire as event\-driven rather than request\-driven, so joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger provisioning, entitlements, device readiness, and access removal with no human in the loop.
* Build the organizational memory that “My Digital Twin” depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action.
* Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection.
* Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity\-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails.
* Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design.

**What we are looking for**
===========================


**Leadership and operating track record**
-----------------------------------------


* Experience leading corporate IT, end\-user services, or workplace technology at global scale, including managing managers and senior technical staff in more than one region.
* A track record of running a demanding environment well while changing it. We will ask for specifics on both.
* Fluency with AI and automation applied to operations: agents, workflow orchestration, integration across identity and ITSM systems, retrieval over internal knowledge. You need to know what is achievable, what is hype, and where the failure modes are.
* Hands\-on depth in endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, MDM platforms, VDI, and AV and conferencing across multiple sites.
* Depth in identity and access (Okta or equivalent), SaaS administration, and public cloud environments.
* Practical experience putting enterprise AI tools in employees’ hands at scale, beyond pilots.
* Vendor management and procurement, plus IT technical program management with globally distributed teams, and the working habits that make distributed leadership effective across time zones.
* Executive presence and influence in a matrix organization, with the ability to develop senior leaders and build a culture of integrity, service excellence, accountability, and best practice sharing across sites.
* Security and compliance are treated as design constraints rather than obstacles, with exposure to SOC 2, SOX, or PCI cycles**.**

**AI\-native depth, in a CorpIT context**
-----------------------------------------


* Demonstrated hands\-on fluency with current generative AI tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where they don’t.


* Experience with AI\-powered digital employee experience management platforms and endpoint telemetry, used to fix problems before employees report them.


* Experience deploying AI assistants or agents inside a corporate stack of identity, MDM, ITSM, and collaboration tools, including where human\-in\-the\-loop approval belongs.


* Experience automating the employee lifecycle end to end, where joiner, mover, and leaver events drove provisioning and access through agentic tooling working from organizational memory rather than from a form.


* Experience running a service as a product measured on employee outcomes rather than ticket counts, with knowledge treated as a maintained asset.


How we will know it is working


* A rising share of employee needs met with a north\-star goal of no ticket ever filed.
* New hires are productive on day one, consistently and without expediting.
* Role changes and departures reflected in access automatically, within minutes.
* Autonomous resolution measured on quality and employee satisfaction, not closure.
* Support capacity per employee improves while experience scores rise, with clean audits throughout.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  


**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.


Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.


### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**


* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------


Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.


Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

title: QA Lead
description:
**QA Tech Lead**


**Location:** \[Bangalore] \| **Experience:** 10\+ years

 **About Us:**



Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals.



For more information, please visit our website https://www.atlassystems.com/

 **Click here to apply for this position**



https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/624

  

  

**About the Role**



We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on QA Tech Lead to own and grow our quality engineering function. You'll combine deep testing expertise with strong leadership. You'll mentor the QA team, shape our automation and test management practices, and lead the adoption of AI tools that make quality work faster and smarter.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Quality Leadership \& Strategy**


* Define and own the overall QA strategy, test approach, and quality standards across products.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to embed quality early in the lifecycle (shift\-left), including requirement reviews and acceptance criteria definition.
* Plan QA effort, estimate testing scope, and manage risk for releases.
* Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage, escape rate, automation coverage, and test cycle time. Use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding QA team members.


**Manual \& Exploratory Testing**


* Lead functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing efforts.
* Champion exploratory testing through well\-defined test charters and session\-based testing.
* Perform deep\-dive testing on complex business workflows, edge cases, and high\-risk areas.
* Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and test strategies.
* Review and approve test artifacts produced by the team.


**Test Management**


* Administer and optimize Qase as the team's primary test management platform.
* Establish standards for test case structure, tagging conventions, suite organization, and traceability to requirements.
* Integrate Qase with issue tracking and CI/CD pipelines so test results and defects are reported automatically.
* Build and present QA dashboards and release\-readiness reports to stakeholders and leadership.


**Test Automation (Playwright)**


* Architect, build, and maintain a scalable end\-to\-end automation framework using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript preferred).
* Define an automation strategy covering UI, API, and cross\-browser testing, guided by the test pyramid.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps) with reliable reporting and parallel execution.
* Set coding standards, lead automation code reviews, and actively reduce flaky tests.
* Set and drive automation coverage targets to steadily reduce manual regression effort.
* Stay hands\-on, contributing automation code alongside the team.


**AI\-Enabled Quality Engineering**


* Use Claude (Anthropic) and other AI tools in daily QA work, including:
	+ generating test cases, exploratory charters, and edge case ideas,
	+ producing test data,
	+ summarizing defects and drafting root cause analyses,
	+ assisting with automation code.
* Develop and share prompt engineering best practices and reusable prompt libraries for QA use cases.
* Set guidelines for responsible AI use, including validating AI\-generated output, protecting sensitive data, and knowing when human judgment is essential.

  


**Nice to Have**


* Exposure to performance testing (k6, JMeter) or security testing fundamentals.
* Experience with visual regression, accessibility (WCAG), or mobile testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and test environment management.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 30 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** AMP – Research \& SI

**Location**Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India

**Reports To**Principal Engineer

**Level** 4


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data\-driven insights, and informed investment decision\-making.


Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high\-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted software development with AI\-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.

**About your role**

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands\-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open\-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI\-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready\-to\-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive\-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third\-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


We’re looking for an experienced, hands\-on AI Engineer who combines strong full\-stack engineering capability with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You are comfortable taking AI\-powered applications and services through design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support within established architecture and engineering standards.


You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and apply AI pragmatically to improve business outcomes and developer productivity without compromising software quality, security, governance, or Responsible AI principles.


You are comfortable contributing to architectural and technical discussions with senior engineers, collaborating with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, and engaging with investment stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI solutions.

**Software Engineering Experience**

* 6\+ years experience in software engineering, including experience leading the technical delivery of complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrable experience building, deploying, and supporting production Generative AI or LLM\-powered applications.
* Strong hands\-on engineering skills in Python and at least one modern frontend stack using TypeScript with Angular / React.
* Experience developing APIs and distributed services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Strong experience with RAG, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, and evaluation.
* Experience building AI agents or orchestrated AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience with LLM capabilities such as structured output, function or tool calling, conversation state, prompt management, and model routing.
* Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions.
* Excellent understanding of modern software engineering principles and design patterns.
* Experience working within Agile software delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, software quality and secure software development practices.
* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and engineering automation.

**AI Engineering Experience**

* Practical experience using AI\-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf or similar LLM\-based engineering assistants.
* Experience integrating AI into software engineering workflows including code generation, documentation, automated testing, code review and developer productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and effective techniques for interacting with Large Language Models.
* Familiarity with emerging AI concepts such as AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic development workflows.
* Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI practices and the effective use of AI within enterprise engineering environments.
* Passion for staying current with developments in AI\-assisted software engineering.

**Technical Skills**


Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:

* Python, Angular, Nodejs, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
* LLM application development and prompt engineering
* Enterprise RAG and vector search
* AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based source control and collaborative development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* CI/CD tooling
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring platforms
* Enterprise architecture principles

**Investment Management Experience**

* Experience delivering technology solutions within Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services.
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back investment management processes.
* Familiarity with technology supporting portfolio management, research, trading, investment risk, investment analytics or asset management operations.
* Experience working closely with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers or front\-office technology teams.
* Understanding of the governance, control and regulatory expectations associated with investment management technology.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passionate about engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Naturally curious about emerging technologies and AI.
* Strong coaching, mentoring and influencing skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Collaborative and delivery\-focused.

title: Principal Engineer - C++
description:
**Principal Engineer \- C\+\+**


**Let’s be unstoppable together!**


Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high\-quality data set.

  



At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

  


**Role Overview:**



We are seeking Principal Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next\-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large\-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22\+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real\-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High\-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low\-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.

  



In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low\-latency, high\-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare\-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi\-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte\-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in\-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* **Architecture \& Design:** Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols.
* **Low\-Level Development:** Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production\-ready backend code utilizing modern C\+\+ (C\+\+20/23\).
* **Parallel Execution Planning:** Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models.
* **Hardware Optimization:** Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX\-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3\).
* **Distributed Memory \& Networks:** Design ultra\-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel\-bypass tech (DPDK).
* **In\-Database ML Framework Design:** Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero\-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines.
* **Functional \& High\-Performance Algorithms:** Develop mathematically rigorous, cache\-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real\-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
* **Vector \& Embedding Infrastructure:** Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high\-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD\-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF\-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.
* Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities.
* Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring.
* Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues.

  


**Required Technical Qualifications:**


* Minimum \- 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
* **Modern C\+\+ Expertise:** 8\+ years of production experience writing hands\-on, low\-level systems in C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key.
* **HPC Parallelism:** Very good to expert\-level knowledge of cluster\-scale distributed programming using **MPI** (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared\-memory thread\-level programming via **OpenMP and MapReduce** frameworks.
* **Hardware\-Aware Engineering:** Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer\-aliasing constraints, and manual **SIMD intrinsics** programming.
* **Concurrency Mechanics:** Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock\-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic).
* **Database Internals:** Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM\-trees, B\-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers).
* Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

  


**Bonus Qualifications:**


* Track record contributing to open\-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox).
* Experience with cloud\-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero\-copy networking.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups.
* Vector \& Graph Algorithmic experience**:** Experience building or modifying high\-performance vector index/search engines, graph\-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks.
* Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

  


**What We Offer**


* Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
* Challenging engineering problems \- all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real\-time analytics at scale.
* Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains.


Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily.

  


**Circana Behaviors:**



Beyond technical skills, experience, and role\-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:


* Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
* Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
* Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
* Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
* Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
* Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
* Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

**Job Description – Manager: Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics**

  


**Role Summary**



We are seeking a Manager in Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics to lead client engagements that use pharmaceutical commercial, real\-world, and digital data to shape strategy and execution.



The role combines deep life sciences domain expertise with analytics leadership, client advisory, and practical knowledge of AI and modern data platforms. The Manager will frame complex business questions, design fit\-for\-purpose analytics and data solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams, and translate evidence into decisions across brand strategy, omnichannel engagement, customer analytics, launch, field effectiveness, and patient analytics.



The ideal candidate will be a credible commercial analytics advisor who can connect pharmaceutical market dynamics with data, technology, and delivery realities — ensuring that solutions are analytically sound, scalable, compliant, and useful to business stakeholders.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Lead Commercial Analytics Strategy and Delivery**
	+ Lead analytics engagements addressing market opportunity, patient journeys, segmentation and targeting, omnichannel performance, launch readiness, field effectiveness, forecasting, and brand performance.
	+ Frame ambiguous client challenges into clear hypotheses, analytical workplans, success measures, and decision points.
	+ Guide the selection and interpretation of pharmaceutical commercial and real\-world data, ensuring that populations, cohorts, business rules, metrics, and limitations are appropriate to the business question.
	+ Own delivery quality, timelines, risks, and executive\-ready outputs across multiple workstreams.
* **Shape AI and Advanced Analytics Solutions**
	+ Identify high\-value applications of machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics across commercial functions, and distinguish viable opportunities from technology\-led experimentation.
	+ Direct the design and validation of solutions such as segmentation, propensity, next\-best\-action, forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP, and AI\-assisted insight generation.
	+ Ensure responsible AI practices, including appropriate data use, transparency, human oversight, performance monitoring, documentation, and compliance with client and regulatory expectations.
	+ Explain model assumptions, limitations, and business trade\-offs to senior stakeholders in accessible language.
* **Provide Data and Solution Architecture Direction**
	+ Guide teams in designing scalable analytical datasets, reusable data models, and robust ETL/ELT pipelines across claims, EHR/EMR, laboratory, SP/HUB, CRM, sales, access, and digital sources.
	+ Set expectations for data quality, lineage, metadata, reproducibility, security, and documentation, and oversee resolution of complex data issues.
	+ Partner with data engineers, architects, data scientists, and visualization specialists to align solution design with analytical needs and enterprise technology standards.
	+ Promote reusable assets, modular code, automation, and cloud\-based delivery approaches that improve quality and speed across engagements.
* **Advise Clients and Translate Evidence into Action**
	+ Act as a trusted advisor to commercial, marketing, sales, market access, analytics, and technology stakeholders.
	+ Synthesize analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and implementation priorities.
	+ Lead workshops and senior stakeholder discussions, challenge assumptions constructively, and build alignment around decisions.
	+ Ensure recommendations reflect pharmaceutical market dynamics, treatment pathways, customer needs, regulatory constraints, and operational feasibility.
* **Lead Teams and Build the Practice**
	+ Lead, coach, and review multidisciplinary teams, creating clarity on roles, standards, timelines, and expected outcomes.
	+ Develop team capability across life sciences domain knowledge, analytics methods, AI, data engineering, quality assurance, and business storytelling.
	+ Contribute to proposals, solution design, thought leadership, reusable accelerators, and the development of EY offerings.
	+ Support account growth by identifying adjacent client needs and articulating differentiated, value\-led solutions.
  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 7–12 years of experience in life sciences commercial analytics, healthcare analytics, analytics consulting, data science, or a related field, including significant responsibility for client and team leadership.
* Deep experience with pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Optum, HealthVerity, TriNetX, EHR/EMR, claims, SP/HUB, laboratory, CRM, sales, market access, and digital engagement data.
* Strong understanding of the US pharmaceutical commercial model and familiarity with global markets, including commercial functions, patient and HCP journeys, therapeutic areas, launch dynamics, and regulatory and privacy considerations.
* Proven leadership across multiple commercial use cases such as patient analytics, segmentation, targeting, omnichannel measurement, marketing mix, field effectiveness, forecasting, launch analytics, or market assessment.
* Experience shaping and overseeing analytics solutions using SQL, Python/R, BI tools, and modern cloud data platforms; sufficient technical depth to review solution design and challenge delivery teams.
* Experience directing data integration and engineering work, including analytical data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data\-quality controls, lineage, and reusable delivery assets.
* Experience designing or governing machine\-learning or generative\-AI solutions, including model validation, adoption, monitoring, and responsible AI considerations.
* Demonstrated experience managing senior client relationships, multidisciplinary teams, project economics, delivery risks, and competing priorities.

  


**Domain and Consulting Skills**


* Deep pharmaceutical commercial and healthcare domain expertise, with credibility in senior business discussions.
* Strategic, hypothesis\-driven problem solving and the ability to structure complex, ambiguous client challenges.
* Ability to connect commercial strategy, analytical methods, AI opportunities, data architecture, and implementation realities.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.
* High standards for analytical rigor, data quality, documentation, and delivery governance.
* Inclusive people leadership, coaching, and performance\-management capability across diverse and distributed teams.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to identify client value, shape proposals, and expand relationships.

  


**Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, data science, business, or a related discipline.
* An MBA or advanced degree in pharma, healthcare, analytics, or a related field is preferred.

  


**Preferred (Good\-to\-Have)**


* Experience supporting US or global pharmaceutical commercial teams.
* Experience in oncology or another complex specialty therapeutic area.
* Experience contributing to consulting proposals, reusable accelerators, or analytics products.

  


**What we look for**



We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish them. We value an entrepreneurial spirit: people who are innovative by nature and continually explore better approaches, products, services, and technologies.



Helping clients solve complex problems and implement practical solutions requires intellectual rigor, commercial judgment, curiosity, and a clear understanding of what works in real delivery environments. We seek people who lead themselves and others effectively, foster inclusive teamwork, and consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes.

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching, and practical experience that enables your continued development.



You will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality, knowledge exchange, and opportunities to build new skills and progress your career.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Security Architect
description:
Role Overview:

In this role, you will assess the security posture of McAfee’s AI solutions, cloud environments, cloud products, and third\-party SaaS services. You will evaluate security architectures and integrations, identify security gaps, and recommend effective remediation, mitigation strategies, and security guardrails. A strong understanding of AI security, cloud security, and regulatory compliance frameworks is essential. You will stay current with emerging technologies and security trends to help ensure McAfee’s systems and services meet the highest standards of security and resilience.

  

This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.


Position Details:
**About This Role:**

* Ensure cloud solutions are designed and implemented in compliance with applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks and conduct regular security assessments to evaluate the security posture of solutions and services.
* Effectively leverage AI\-powered tools to enhance security architecture reviews while continuously developing expertise in AI technologies, emerging threats, and evolving ways of working.
* Evaluate security architectures and designs to assess the adequacy of security controls, identify security gaps, and recommend appropriate remediation, mitigation strategies, and security guardrails.
* Assess SaaS platforms and integrations to determine the effectiveness and adequacy of their security design.
* Perform a variety of security\-related activities, including but not limited to threat modeling, knowledge transfer sessions, and security training.
* Continuously identify, define, and recommend security guardrails that can be implemented across multiple Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).
* Champion security across the organization by collaborating with security champions, security teams, and business units to develop and deliver secure solutions that protect McAfee’s data and systems.
* Stay current with the latest security trends, emerging threats, industry best practices, and evolving technologies.
* Contribute to the creation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cloud security policies, standards, principles, and procedures.

 **About You:**

* You should have 5\-9 years of experience in cloud security architecture, with hands\-on experience in one or more major Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* You should have experience with cloud\-native security guardrails, security services, and third\-party security tools.
* You should have experience with AI tools, automation, copilots, custom GPTs, LLM\-based applications, MCP servers, or workflow solutions that support security architecture reviews.
* You should possess strong knowledge of cloud networking architecture, network security, cloud IAM (Identity and Access Management), authentication, authorization, application security protocols, and cryptography.
* You should have experience with containerization and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, which is strongly preferred.
* You should have an understanding of cloud automation and orchestration tools and techniques.
* You should be passionate about cloud security and demonstrate the initiative to drive outcomes despite ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* You should possess a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
* You should be committed to staying current with the latest cloud security best practices, standards, and emerging technologies.
* You should demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, along with resourcefulness.
* You should preferably hold, or be working toward, a recognized cloud security certification such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, ISC2 CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional), or CSA CCSK (Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge).

title: Sr Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
**Job Description: Solution Engineer – Context Graph Demo Specialist**

**Company:** Tata Communications
  

**Function:** Solution Engineering
  

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor (IC)
  

**Experience:** Fresher – 2 years
  

**Locations:** Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram
  

**Travel:** 40–50% (on\-site customer demos)


**About the Role**

Tata Communications is looking for an early\-career Solution Engineer to join the Solution Engineering team, focused on building and delivering demonstrations of our Context Graph capabilities. This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role for someone who enjoys translating technical concepts into compelling business stories, thinks logically under pressure, and is comfortable being on the road to present in front of customers.


You'll work closely with senior solution architects, product, and sales teams to build demo environments, customize them for specific customer use cases, and present them live — both virtually and on\-site.


**Key Responsibilities**

* **Demo Build \& Ownership:** Build, configure, and maintain demo environments for Context Graph, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and are tailored to different industry use cases.
* **Customer\-Facing Demos:** Travel to customer locations (40–50% travel) to deliver live product demonstrations, walk through use cases, and answer first\-level technical questions.
* **Use Case Translation:** Work with sales and solution architects to understand a prospect's business problem and translate it into a relevant, believable demo narrative — not just a feature walkthrough.
* **Troubleshooting on the Fly:** Diagnose and resolve demo environment issues quickly, including during live customer sessions, with a calm and structured approach.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to stay current on roadmap changes, feedback loops from the field, and competitive positioning.
* **Documentation:** Maintain demo scripts, environment setup guides, and reusable assets so demos can scale across the team.
* **Continuous Learning:** Build depth in graph data concepts, knowledge graphs, and how Context Graph fits into broader enterprise data and AI strategies.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must\-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (freshers welcome) or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Strong logical and analytical thinking — able to break down a customer problem and map it to a technical solution.
* Ontology\-first thinking — demonstrated ability to model an enterprise’s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
* Basic understanding of data structures, databases, or graph concepts (formal experience not required, but genuine curiosity and aptitude expected).
* Good business acumen — able to understand a customer's commercial context, not just their technical ask.
* Comfortable with public speaking / presenting to small and large groups, including senior stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to travel 40–50% of the time for on\-site customer demos.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Good to Have (not mandatory):**

* Exposure to graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, etc.) or knowledge graph concepts.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, or basic scripting.
* Prior internship or project experience involving customer\-facing work, hackathons, or product demos.
* Understanding of enterprise IT, telecom, or B2B SaaS environments.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Demo environments are reliable, current, and reusable across the team.
* Customers leave demo sessions with a clear understanding of how Context Graph solves their specific problem.
* You build a reputation internally as someone who can be trusted to represent the product in front of a customer.
* You progress toward owning more complex, custom\-built demos and eventually pre\-sales solutioning independently.

**Why Join Tata Communications**

* Front\-row seat to how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt cutting\-edge graph and AI\-driven solutions.
* Direct mentorship from senior solution architects and exposure to the full sales cycle.
* Fast\-tracked learning curve: technical depth \+ commercial exposure \+ customer\-facing skills, all in one role.
* Clear growth path into Solution Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Product roles.

Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and AI\-powered Salesforce capabilities.

description:
**About Us:**  



  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

 **Target Tech Overview:**


Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.

  

Our global in\-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open\-source software to adapt and build best\-in\-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.

 **Pyramid Overview:**


The Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity — the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data\-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost\-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self\-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. Following an infrastructure\-as\-code philosophy, we treat repeatability, resilience, and security as first\-class engineering outcomes rather than afterthoughts. We partner closely with platform and product teams to onboard new workloads, drive cloud cost stewardship, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, availability, and readiness for our highest\-traffic events. As a lead engineer on this team, you'll help shape cloud strategy, architect platform capabilities and tooling, and set technical direction that multiplies the productivity of engineers across the company — a high\-impact role at the center of how Target builds in the cloud.

  

As a Senior Engineer on the Cloud Enablement team, you'll contribute:

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, deploy, and support scalable cloud platform capabilities using cloud services, preferably **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, with a strong focus on reliability, security, automation, and developer experience in **Golang.**
* Implement cloud engineering best practices across resource provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, observability, security, governance, and cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** technologies to automate infrastructure deployment and configuration.
* Build and maintain APIs, automation services, and operational tooling that simplify cloud operations and improve engineering productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting and advancing automation, orchestration, **GitOps, self\-service tooling, and reusable platform patterns**.
* Apply your technical expertise and stay current with emerging technologies and practices across cloud computing, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and DevOps.
* Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical decision\-making. Initiate and execute research and proof\-of\-concept activities to assess new technologies and approaches.
* Provide technical guidance for both routine and complex engineering challenges, including troubleshooting issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing. Escalate issues when appropriate.
* Participate in complex design, construction, automation, migration, and implementation initiatives, ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices for monitoring, testing, automation, security, and maintenance of cloud platform components, infrastructure services, and shared engineering capabilities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the organization’s technical capabilities, cloud infrastructure, platform services, and broader technology environment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Four\-year degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years of experience** in software development **(Golang),** cloud engineering **(Google Cloud),** platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering, with a focus on cloud services.
* Strong domain knowledge of cloud platforms, including **account/project management, compute, storage, databases, networking, serverless technologies, IAM, security, observability, and cost management**.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as **Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane**, or similar tools.
* Experience developing **APIs, automation, and operational tooling** using **Golang, Python, and Bash scripting**.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies including **Docker, Kubernetes**, and managed Kubernetes platforms such as **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing technologies such as **OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Google Cloud Operations, Splunk, Datadog**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Linux environments, virtual machines, containers, networking, DNS, load balancing, and cloud\-native runtime environments.
* Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with project teams, application teams, partners, and stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in analyzing and optimizing **system capacity, performance, reliability, scalability, security, and operational health**.

Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. This is a hands\-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production.


You will own features end to end — data model, app, automation, integration and security — on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders.
