title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Role Description:
**About us**
------------


Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

**Business Overview**
---------------------


From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

**Role Description**
--------------------


As a SAP Workload Automation and Basis Engineer, you will establish and operate the scheduling and workload automation capability for our Financial Systems. Your primary focus will be SAP workloads, while the capability will also cover connected non\-SAP workloads across on\-premises, cloud and SAP RISE.

  

You will define how jobs and business processes are scheduled, coordinated, monitored and controlled. This includes designing reliable and well performing job chains, establishing safeguards for both the schedule and the systems, creating policies and operational documentation, and enabling AMS partners to execute workloads consistently within clear guardrails.

  

This is a foundational role. You will help build the capability around a new platform. You will create the technical and operational foundations that can scale over time, acquiring central relevance.

  

The role sits within the SAP Basis team. A strong SAP Basis foundation is required, enabling a vertical capability across the technical landscape, system performance, monitoring, business processes, SAP lifecycle roadmap. The role will engage on a daily basis with platform engineers, functional and application teams, aligning scheduling practices with business requirements.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Design and establish a robust scheduling and orchestration framework for SAP and connected non\-SAP workloads.
* Define standards for job design, dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling, reruns and recovery.
* Maintain an inventory of critical jobs, job chains and end\-to\-end financial processes, including ownership, dependencies and operational impact.
* Ensure that scheduling patterns are reliable, auditable, secure and maintainable across SAP, BTP, RISE and cloud AWS, os\-level, on\-prem, third party environments.
* Write and maintain scheduling policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks and operational documentation.
* Establish safeguards for high\-risk workloads, financial close activities, sensitive data flows, conflicting activities and emergency execution.
* Establish auditable quality gates and guardrails providing reliable, efficient, high performing scheduling.
* Define the operating model through which AMS partners execute scheduling and operational requests.
* Convert policies into practical runbooks, checklists, approval requirements and control points that AMS teams can follow consistently.
* Provide independent oversight of execution quality, adherence to policy, incident trends, SLA performance and recurring operational risks.
* Improve the model over time so that governance removes blockers and reduces manual risk without creating unnecessary queues or bureaucracy.
* Contribute to an observability framework that provides visibility into end\-to\-end financial processes, not only individual job outcomes.
* Define meaningful metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerts for process timeliness, completeness, dependency health and business impact.
* Partner with platform, application and observability teams to connect scheduling signals with incident management and operational response.
* Contribute to incident management, problem management, post\-incident reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate recurring failures and identify improvements to job design, dependencies, capacity, monitoring, documentation or operating procedures.
* Support change and release planning for scheduling components and critical process chains.
* Ensure appropriate controls for SOx, DORA, NIST\-aligned practices, internal security standards, segregation of duties and auditability.
* Work closely with SAP Basis engineers, application owners, Finance stakeholders, architects, security teams, platform teams and AMS partners.
* Explain technical scheduling and orchestration concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Share knowledge and help build a community of practice around scheduling, orchestration and process observability.
* Help shape the future organization, roles and responsibilities as the capability grows and may evolve into a dedicated team.

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* 5 to 8 years of experience in workload automation and Basis.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise job scheduling, batch processing or workload automation in a complex technology environment.
* Experience designing job chains with dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling and recovery procedures.
* Strong understanding of scheduling and orchestration principles across heterogeneous environments, including SAP and non\-SAP workloads.
* Experience creating operational policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks or similar documentation for technology operations.
* Practical experience working with operations teams, managed service providers or AMS partners through defined processes and controls.
* Strong awareness of observability concepts, including metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerting.
* Ability to connect technical monitoring with end\-to\-end business or financial processes.
* SAP Basis technical experience, with a good understanding of SAP landscapes, HANA and S/4HANA.
* Goo conceptual knowledge of Linux, databases and networking.
* Scripting or automation experience, for example with Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of security topics, segregation of duties, auditability and change management in regulated environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience with one or more enterprise scheduling or orchestration platforms, such as SAP Central Process Scheduling, Redwood, Control\-M, Automic or equivalent products.
* Experience with SAP on HANA, S/4HANA, Central Finance, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP or SAP\-related integration technologies.
* Experience operating in hybrid or cloud environments and integrating scheduling with APIs, event\-driven services, data pipelines or cloud\-native workloads.
* Experience with process\-level monitoring, business process observability or proactive operations.
* Experience in FinTech, banking, travel, retail or another regulated, high\-volume enterprise environment.
* Experience contributing to technology product selection, proof\-of\-concept work or platform implementation.
* Familiarity with SOx, DORA, NIST or comparable regulatory and control frameworks.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

  

From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

* Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data\-centric and AI\-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for AI\-driven solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.



Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  


**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.



Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  


**The opportunity**



We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.


**Your key responsibilities**


* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.

* Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.

* Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.

* Cloud‑native storage and processing services
* Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
* Networking and identity models
* Security, encryption, and access controls

* Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.
* Platform Development \& Engineering Enablement
* Partner with Platform Engineers and Data Engineers to translate architecture into reusable platform capabilities, frameworks, and templates.
* Define configuration‑driven and template‑based approaches to accelerate onboarding and reduce bespoke development.
* Review and guide detailed solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
* Enable self‑service platform usage while preserving governance and operational controls.
* Governance, Metadata \& Lineage Architecture
* Define the governance architecture for the Lakehouse, including metadata management, lineage, access control, and auditability.
* Ensure support for open metadata and lineage standards (e.g., OpenLineage‑style event models).
* Embed data quality, ownership, discoverability, and compliance as first‑class architectural concerns.
* Align platform design with enterprise data governance and regulatory expectations.
* Operational Excellence \& Non‑Functional Architecture
* Architect for high availability, observability, and operational simplicity.
* Define platform‑level SLAs, SLOs, and operational readiness criteria.
* Incorporate FinOps principles into architectural decisions to optimize performance and cost.
* Ensure the platform supports Day‑2 operations, incident management, and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder Leadership \& Architecture Governance

* Clearly communicate architectural vision and decisions through architecture documents, standards, and review forums.
* Lead architecture reviews, roadmap planning, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising overall platform and architecture maturity.

### **Required Qualifications**


* 16\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture roles.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise‑scale data platforms.
* Strong experience designing and governing Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands‑on architectural experience with AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to design for both.
* Deep understanding of open data standards, including open table formats, file formats, metadata, and lineage.
* Experience defining reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering standards.
* Strong ability to balance long‑term architectural vision with near‑term delivery needs.


Preferred / Optional Qualifications


* Experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services (optional, not required).
* Experience designing multi‑cloud or cloud‑agnostic data platforms.
* Familiarity with multiple analytics and query engines across cloud ecosystems.

title: Global Product Cyber Security Expert – R&D Digital Portfolio EM&AO
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Digital Solution Engineering Manager \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.



You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.



The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.



In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.



You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)



Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***



Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.



You will be mainly accountable for:


**Cyber Security Management:**



Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.



Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, risks and take proactive measures to address them.



Respond promptly to security incidents.



Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.


**Compliance and Risk Management:**



Stay up to date with industry Standards \& Compliance, regulations, and best practices related to cyber security and cloud computing, such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443 SL3\.



Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.



Collaborate with internal teams and external auditors to ensure adherence to compliance requirements and address any findings, incidents or recommendations by executing and coordinating: investigation, schedule, corrective actions and disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.


**Other responsibilities/skills:**


* Collaborate with all organization members to contribute to the overall software development lifecycle in assigned areas and reach targets, share knowledge and contribute to a positive work atmosphere
* Follow agile software development practices to build and deliver software in an iterative and incremental manner as part of a global team’s scrum\-based development process
* Continue your personal learning journey by staying abreast of new and evolving software engineering technologies and sharing knowledge with team members
* A high level of self\-motivation, curiosity, as well as a strong desire and ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues
* Project management capabilities
* Scrum and Agile methodologies knowledge
* Ensure that CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices incorporate cybersecurity controls and security testing requirements.


**Qualifications for the role**


* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.


Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP) preferred.



10 years of proven experience in product or system cybersecurity for industrial or critical systems.



5 years in cloud computing, with a strong understanding of security principles, technologies, and best practices.



Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including proficiency in cloud services and management tools. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines.



Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Podman for container orchestration and management.



Proficiency in OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and identity management solutions such as Keycloak.



Experience with Helm charts for managing Kubernetes applications and deployments.



Strong understanding of the design and architecture of microservices, including principles such as loose coupling, bounded contexts, and domain\-driven design.



Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work cross\-functionally with internal teams geographically distributed.



Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment, while also collaborating effectively as part of a global team.



Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, eventually German if location is Germany. Willing to travel, time to time, for office/site visit.



This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.\*


*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Pharmacy
description:

Join Amazon Pharmacy's ambitious mission to build a next\-generation Pharmacy fulfillment technology that is reshaping healthcare delivery. As a founding member of our new Bangalore team, you'll architect and develop mission\-critical fulfillment technology that ensures medication safety for millions while enabling rapid delivery capabilities to scale the business. You'll work on complex distributed systems handling inventory management, order orchestration, and compliance\-critical workflows, building from the ground up using Amazon's latest cloud\-native technologies and AI/ML capabilities.  

The ideal candidate brings strong systems design experience, expertise in building highly available services, and passion for solving challenging technical problems where quality and compliance are paramount. You'll have the opportunity to integrate with latest robotics and automation systems, while leveraging AI to optimize delivery speeds, enhance accuracy, and improve operational efficiency.  

Amazon Pharmacy is transforming how customers access healthcare by combining Amazon's customer obsession and operational excellence with pharmacy services \- making it easier for customers to find, purchase, and receive their medications. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the technical foundation of this rapidly growing business while directly impacting customer healthcare experiences. Your work will be instrumental in scaling Amazon's pharmacy operations and building technology that could fundamentally change how customers access their medications. If you're excited about building large\-scale systems that require precision while maintaining Amazon\-scale performance, we want to talk to you !  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software solutions that enable new features and improvements across major portions of your team's systems, balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term maintainability.
* Own the full software development lifecycle for your projects, including product definition, scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational support.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful and constructive feedback to teammates, and coach others on producing high\-quality, well\-documented code.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross\-functional peers to understand business and customer value, ensuring you deliver the right solutions to the right problems.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's processes and system reliability.

  

About the team  

Amazon’s mission is to make it dramatically easier for customers to access the healthcare products and services they need to get and stay healthy.. Towards this mission, Amazon Pharmacy Fulfillment Tech strives to build technology to fulfill the world’s healthcare needs as fast as possible at the highest quality, lowest cost, and greatest convenience. * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Cloud Infrastructure Architect – Nutanix

Full Time

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. * Ability to manage projects, teams, and stakeholders effectively
* Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Strong communication and client\-facing experience
* Experience in Agile/DevOps environments

* 11–12 years of industry experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* + Nutanix AOS, AHV, Prism Central
	+ Cluster deployment, upgrades, and lifecycle management
	+ Storage policies, replication, DR strategies

* Understanding of security and compliance frameworks

* Experience with NC2 (Nutanix Cloud Platform on AWS/Azure)
* Knowledge of DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Experience in governance models (RBAC, quotas, categories)

* Manage team allocation, performance evaluation, and mentoring
* Oversee project planning, budgeting, and delivery timelines
* Conduct client meetings, status reporting, and stakeholder communication
* Drive team productivity and delivery excellence
* Participate in hiring and team building activities

  


**What We Look For**


* Strong technical consulting and architecture experience
* Passion for cloud and infrastructure transformation
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment
* Continuous learner with focus on innovation and improvement

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS OpenSearch
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.  

  

Imagine being a part of a small, agile team where your ideas have the potential to reach millions within a short span of time. Picture working on technologies, where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision\-making process. Envision being able to leverage the resources of a Fortune\-500 company within the atmosphere of a start\-up.  

AWS OpenSearch team is looking for Software Development Engineers for its Bangalore team who can help build search technologies for customers of all sizes. If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you.  

  

You are highly\-motivated and thrive in an environment where problems are open\-ended. You enjoy engaging in passionate discussions with smart people and letting the best ideas rise to the top. You see your mistakes as learning opportunities and continually look for ways to improve yourself, your team and your products. You understand that not all solutions come easily and don’t shy away from hard work to reach your goals.  

We are looking for smart, motivated Software Development Engineers who can help take the service to new heights. If you have the skills to building large\-scale and high\-performance services, this is the job for you.  

  

As an AWS OpenSearch engineer you will: \- Design, develop, and support a world\-class OpenSearch platform that manages thousands of search domains.  

  

Contribute to both open source code and managed service platform.  

Work with senior engineers in the team to deliver many components of the entire stack.  

Focus on scalability, performance, service robustness, and cost trade\-offs. (Especially as they pertain to a highly\-virtualised, elastic, cloud\-based environment).  

Apply scientific analysis and mathematical modelling techniques to predict, measure, and evaluate the consequences of designs and the ongoing success of our platform.  

Continuously drive to explore, improve, enhance, automate, and optimize distributed systems and tools to best meet evolving business and market needs.  

Work alongside a dedicated operations team to develop and support the smooth 24x7 operation of our worldwide service.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Job Summary**


As a Senior Technical Lead, you will lead end\-to\-end development of product features and act as a technical bridge between Architects, Product Management, and the engineering team. You will contribute hands\-on to building and validating secure, high\-quality solutions (with strong unit test coverage), troubleshoot and resolve customer escalations, and drive innovation through PoCs and continuous technical improvements across our Java/cloud\-native stack (e.g., Spring Boot, Kubernetes, microservices, and deployments).

**Job Requirement and Responsibilities**

* Senior Technical lead will be responsible for leading autonomously the product feature developments, maintaining or developing/architecting software applications and systems.
* He should be technically adequate to work as an individual contributor, and work as a bridge between Architects and Product Management and the team.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be any constraints for the right person, we work on Java, React, Kotlin, Kubernetes, and maintain/own the deployments and charts definitions for our applications.

**Job Knowledge, Skill and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/computer engineering/Electronics and Communication 10\+ years of application development on Java and cloud tech stack.
* Strong experience in implementing Rest API based applications using Java tech stack with strong knowledge of Spring, Spring Boot frameworks.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular will be an added advantage.

**What do we offer?**


At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Manager, AI & Data Engineering
description:
**R****o****le****:** Manager, AI \& Data Engineering

**Location****:** Bangalore

**Full/ Part\-time****:** Full time

**About Carrier**

  

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life\-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

* **About the role****:**

Designs, builds, and evolves enterprise data and AI capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and scalable digital solutions across the organization. Oversees data platforms, pipelines, analytics, and intelligent technologies to ensure high\-quality, accessible, and well\-governed data that supports operational and strategic decision\-making. Applies advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and business performance while enabling scalable and data\-driven ways of working. Establishes and enforces governance frameworks, standards, and responsible AI practices to maintain data integrity, compliance, consistency, and trusted use of enterprise technologies. Partners closely with business and technology teams to translate evolving business needs into robust data and AI solutions that drive innovation, operational maturity, and long\-term enterprise value. **JOB RESPONSIBILITY:**


1\. Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership

* Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.
* Act as the final technical authority for platform‑level architectural decisions, trade‑offs, and exceptions.
* Ensure architectural choices support scalability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.


2\. Lakehouse \& Open‑Standards Strategy

* Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.
* Standardize on open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg or equivalent) and open file formats (e.g., Parquet) as the foundation of the Lakehouse.
* Enforce separation of storage and compute, enabling multiple analytics and processing engines without vendor lock‑in.
* Define principles for schema evolution, ACID guarantees, time travel, and multi‑engine interoperability.


3\. Multi‑Cloud Platform Design (AWS \& GCP)

* Architect the Lakehouse platform to run on AWS and GCP, with cloud‑specific implementations mapped to a common logical architecture.
* Define standards and patterns for:
* Cloud‑native storage and processing services
* Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
* Networking and identity models
* Security, encryption, and access controls
* Establish cloud‑agnostic abstractions and guardrails so data products behave consistently across clouds.
* Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.


4\. Platform Development \& Engineering Enablement

* Partner with Platform Engineers and Data Engineers to translate architecture into reusable platform capabilities, frameworks, and templates.
* Define configuration‑driven and template‑based approaches to accelerate onboarding and reduce bespoke development.
* Review and guide detailed solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
* Enable self‑service platform usage while preserving governance and operational controls.


5\. Governance, Metadata \& Lineage Architecture

* Define the governance architecture for the Lakehouse, including metadata management, lineage, access control, and auditability.
* Ensure support for open metadata and lineage standards (e.g., OpenLineage‑style event models).
* Embed data quality, ownership, discoverability, and compliance as first‑class architectural concerns.
* Align platform design with enterprise data governance and regulatory expectations.


6\. Operational Excellence \& Non‑Functional Architecture

* Architect for high availability, observability, and operational simplicity.
* Define platform‑level SLAs, SLOs, and operational readiness criteria.
* Incorporate FinOps principles into architectural decisions to optimize performance and cost.
* Ensure the platform supports Day‑2 operations, incident management, and continuous improvement.


7\. Stakeholder Leadership \& Architecture Governance

* Serve as the primary architecture interface between engineering teams, security, governance, and business stakeholders.
* Clearly communicate architectural vision and decisions through architecture documents, standards, and review forums.
* Lead architecture reviews, roadmap planning, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising overall platform and architecture maturity.


Required Qualifications

* 16\+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture roles.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise‑scale data platforms.
* Strong experience designing and governing Lakehouse architectures.
* Hands‑on architectural experience with AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to design for both.
* Deep understanding of open data standards, including open table formats, file formats, metadata, and lineage.
* Experience defining reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering standards.
* Strong ability to balance long‑term architectural vision with near‑term delivery needs.


Preferred / Optional Qualifications

* Experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services (optional, not required).
* Experience designing multi‑cloud or cloud‑agnostic data platforms.
* Familiarity with multiple analytics and query engines across cloud ecosystems.
* Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and metadata platforms.
* Exposure to AI/ML platform integration on Lakehouse architectures.
* Prior experience leading large‑scale platform modernization or migration initiatives **Benefits**

title: Sr. Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Location**
------------


Bengaluru


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Revenue


  
**About G2 \- The Company**  

  



G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.


Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M\+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.


And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.


Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!


**About G2 \- Our People**


At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance \+ *E*ntrepreneurship \+ *A*uthenticity \+ *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value\-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.


You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals \- each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people\-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.


**About The Role:**
-------------------


G2 is looking for a Salesforce Engineer based in Bangalore, India to serve as the primary technical partner embedded with our sales and revenue\-facing business stakeholders, someone who can move fluidly from a conversation about pipeline OKRs to writing Apex code to shipping a solution in production.


This is a hybrid role based out of our Bangalore office for regular in\-person collaboration.It is a high\-autonomy, high\-ownership role. You are the engineer, the analyst, the architect, and the delivery owner. You will operate across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Accounting to understand what they need, design the right solution, build it, test it, deploy it, and iterate on it. If you thrive in environments where you can see the direct impact of what you build on the revenue teams depending on it every day and where you're expected to bring both technical depth and business judgment, this role is for you.


**In This Role, You Will Focus On:**
------------------------------------


* Partnering directly with Sales, Marketing, Partner, and Revenue Accounting stakeholders including collaborating across time zones with G2's US\-based teams to understand goals, OKRs, and process friction, translating them into technical solutions without a PM or BSA intermediary
* Owning the full delivery lifecycle: requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing iteration
* Building and maintaining solutions across G2's revenue tech stack, including Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ), Gong, ZoomInfo, and Slack and evaluating new tools as the GTM ecosystem evolves
* Developing within Salesforce using both declarative configuration and custom code writing Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) for solutions that go beyond what clicks can deliver
* Designing and deploying AI\-powered GTM workflows leveraging Claude Code, Dust, and native AI capabilities within the stack to automate and augment how Sales and Marketing teams operate, from lead routing to pipeline hygiene to revenue recognition support
* Maintaining the reliability, performance, and governance of the systems you own including documentation, change management, and proactive monitoring

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------


We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.


* 8\+ years of experience in a Salesforce\-centric technical role, with demonstrated ownership of solution delivery end\-to\-end
* Salesforce development proficiency: Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs), Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and platform configuration (flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets)
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CPQ including quote configuration, pricing rules, approval workflows, and order management
* Experience working directly with Sales and Marketing business stakeholders comfortable running discovery conversations, scoping solutions, and managing delivery expectations without a PM layer
* Familiarity with one or more tools in the revenue tech ecosystem: Gong, ZoomInfo, or comparable GTM platforms
* Demonstrated ability to operate without a PM or QA function you write your own test cases, own your own deployments, and catch your own bugs
* Comfort with AI\-assisted development workflows and genuine curiosity about applying LLMs and AI agents to Sales and Marketing operations
* Strong written and verbal communication able to collaborate effectively across time zones with US\-based stakeholders and explain technical decisions to non\-technical business partners
* Must be based in Bangalore, India or within commutable distance to the Bangalore office

**What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:**

description:
**About Vista Equity Partners** 




 Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.
 



 Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. 
 



**About Amtech** 




 Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.
 



 With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. 
 



**Our Employee Value Proposition** 




 At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:
 



**Purpose** 




 Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.
 



**Growth** 




 Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.
 



**Culture** 




 Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.
 



**Innovation** 




 Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. 
 



**Role Description** 




 Amtech is seeking an experienced
 **Performance Test Architect** 
 to define and drive the performance engineering strategy for enterprise\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in performance testing, workload modeling, capacity planning, observability, application bottleneck analysis, and production\-readiness validation.
 



 This role requires someone who can operate beyond traditional performance testing—partnering with architects, developers, DevOps/SRE teams, product owners, and engineering leadership to identify scalability risks early, establish measurable non\-functional requirements, and ensure systems can reliably support expected business growth and peak workloads.
 



 The profile is particularly suited to someone with extensive experience leading performance engineering for high\-throughput systems, microservices, cloud platforms, messaging systems, e\-commerce, and customer\-facing applications, including load testing, capacity planning, JVM/database analysis, observability, Kubernetes, and distributed systems. 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Performance Strategy \& Architecture** 
  
 


* Define performance engineering strategies, standards, NFRs, KPIs, SLAs/SLOs, workload models, and release criteria.
* Participate in requirements, architecture, database, infrastructure, and design reviews to identify performance risks early.
* Design and execute baseline, load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, capacity, volume, failover, and resilience tests.
* Develop realistic workload models based on customer usage, business volumes, production traffic, concurrency, and forecasted growth.
* Develop reusable performance solutions using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or similar tools.
* Establish production\-readiness and performance quality criteria for major releases.



**Performance Analysis \& Optimization** 
  
 


* Analyze response time, throughput, latency, concurrency, error rates, CPU, memory, network, database, and infrastructure utilization.
* Identify bottlenecks across UI, APIs, microservices, databases, messaging, network, infrastructure, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Correlate logs, APM data, distributed traces, database metrics, infrastructure telemetry, and application code to identify root causes.
* Perform JVM, threading, connection\-pool, caching, timeout, retry, queue, and autoscaling analysis.
* Perform SQL performance analysis including execution plans, indexing, locking, blocking, waits, I/O, and connection pooling.
* Partner with engineering teams to recommend, implement, and validate performance optimizations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis of production performance issues and recurring regressions.



**Scalability, Capacity \& Resilience** 
  
 


* Validate horizontal and vertical scalability, autoscaling, application stability, and infrastructure capacity.
* Develop capacity models and recommend infrastructure sizing based on workload growth and utilization trends.
* Analyze Kubernetes pods, CPU/memory limits, HPA behavior, database capacity, thread pools, connections, and queue depths.
* Validate application behavior during peak workloads, infrastructure saturation, downstream failures, failover, and recovery.
* Support capacity planning and production readiness for major launches and business\-critical events.
* Identify cloud and infrastructure optimization opportunities while maintaining performance and reliability.



**Automation \& Continuous Performance Testing** 
  
 


* Build reusable performance testing frameworks, utilities, and automated regression suites.
* Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or equivalent tools.
* Automate test data preparation, execution, monitoring, analysis, baseline comparison, and reporting.
* Establish automated performance quality gates and regression detection.
* Track performance baselines and trends across releases to proactively identify degradation before production.



**Observability \& Front\-End Performance** 
  
 


* Define observability requirements and create dashboards for performance analysis and production\-readiness assessments.
* Use tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, Kibana, and InfluxDB.
* Evaluate browser performance, Core Web Vitals, page rendering, network activity, and responsiveness using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or Playwright tracing.



**Quality Engineering \& Technical Leadership** 
  
 


* Collaborate with Quality Engineers, Developers, Architects, Database, DevOps/SRE, and Infrastructure teams on functional and non\-functional quality.
* Produce clear performance reports highlighting findings, trends, risks, capacity constraints, and recommendations.
* Mentor engineers on performance engineering practices and promote a performance\-first quality mindset.
* Represent Performance Engineering in architecture, design, and release\-readiness reviews.
* Introduce approved AI\-assisted performance engineering approaches for workload modeling, script generation, log analysis, result interpretation, RCA, and defect investigation.



**Skills \& Qualifications** 
  
 


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 12\+ years of Quality/Performance Engineering experience, with significant hands\-on performance engineering expertise.
* Experience as a Performance Architect, Principal Performance Engineer, Performance Lead, or equivalent senior technical role.
* Strong experience with JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, or equivalent tools.
* Strong knowledge of workload modeling, scalability, capacity planning, resilience, and performance analysis.
* Experience with On\-Premises, SaaS, cloud, hybrid, microservices, and distributed applications.
* Strong understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, caching, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Strong SQL and database performance troubleshooting skills; experience with SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL is desirable.
* Experience with Java/JVM performance concepts including GC, memory, threading, and concurrency.
* Experience with observability/APM platforms and distributed tracing.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Windows Server, networking, containers, Kubernetes, AWS and/or Azure.
* Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Programming or scripting experience in JavaScript, Java, Python, C\#, Shell, or similar languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, mentoring, and stakeholder\-management skills.



**Preferred Experience** 
  
 


* High\-throughput and highly concurrent enterprise applications.
* SaaS, retail, telecom, e\-commerce, messaging, or customer\-facing platforms.
* Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar distributed technologies.
* Cloud capacity optimization and infrastructure right\-size.
* Resilience and production\-readiness engineering.
* AI\-assisted performance analysis and engineering automation.



**Why Join Amtech** 
  
 



 At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech —
 **backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.**

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.



As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.



You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.


* Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
* Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.


Key job responsibilities


* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


A day in the life


* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.



The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience

* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
