title: Senior Account Manager, TSG, IT & ITES, AWS India
description:
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.



AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.



As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end\-to\-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high\-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology\-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C\-suite executives, influencing multi\-year technology decisions and driving large\-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next\-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi\-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment\-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go\-to\-market priorities.



Key job responsibilities


* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long\-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi\-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud\-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO\-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi\-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single\-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go\-to\-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations.


A day in the life As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large\-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.



A typical day may include:



Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi\-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.



Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep\-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.



Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go\-to\-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.



Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi\-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals. Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.



Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations.



About the team About the team The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud\-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high\-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.



Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C\-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data\-driven transition business cases and risk\-adjusted transition plans during pre\-sales
* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech\-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI\-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto\-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI\-powered documentation tools to auto\-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI\-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi\-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real\-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go\-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50\+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI\-powered project analytics tools and NLP\-based status reporting to auto\-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go\-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on\-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post\-go\-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents
* Use ML\-based SLA prediction models to benchmark incoming team performance trajectories and forecast BAU stabilization timelines

**Requirements**

* 12–18 years of IT industry experience with significant tenure leading enterprise Application Transition programs
* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on experience transitioning Application Development portfolios within Managed Services or IT Outsourcing environments
* Proven track record managing transitions of 200\+ FTEs and 100\+ applications across multi\-geo delivery models
* Hands\-on exposure to AI tools and automation platforms used across the transition lifecycle (code analysis, documentation generation, test automation, AIOps)
* Experience managing transitions in Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models; able to adapt governance to match client maturity
* Demonstrated ability to manage 50\+ active stakeholders, including CXOs, Product Owners, Architects, and Vendor Leads
* Strong pre\-sales experience: RFP/RFI responses, SOW development, contract reviews, and client oral presentations

**Location:** Hyderabad / Hybrid

**Function:** Business Consulting / Digital Transformation / Enterprise Architecture

Role Purpose
  
  

We are looking for a business\-oriented Enterprise Architect to lead technology strategy and architecture workstreams across complex digital transformation engagements.The Enterprise Architect will work with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate enterprise strategy, business capabilities, value streams and future\-state processes into integrated application, data, integration, infrastructure and security architectures. The role will typically operate during Phase 0, discovery, assessment and transformation\-planning engagements, helping customers establish the case for change, evaluate strategic platform options and define an actionable transformation roadmap.The successful candidate will combine architecture depth with strong consulting, facilitation and commercial skills. The role requires the ability to move from current\-state diagnosis to target architecture, prioritized initiatives, business\-case inputs and implementation mobilization.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead enterprise architecture and technology strategy workstreams across digital and business transformation engagements.
  
Establish pragmatic architecture methods, principles, standards, viewpoints and decision criteria.
  
Assess current business capabilities, processes, applications, data, integrations, infrastructure, cloud services, security controls and technology risks.
  
Develop business capability maps, value\-stream architectures and traceability between business requirements, processes, applications and data.
  
Define integrated target architectures covering business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity domains.
  
Translate future\-state processes and operating\-model requirements into technology capabilities, solution options and architecture decisions.
  
Lead digital\-core, ERP, CRM, supply chain, manufacturing, asset\-management, data\-platform and enterprise\-application strategy assessments.
  
Evaluate strategic platforms and vendors based on business fit, architecture fit, scalability, integration, data, security, cost, implementation risk and organizational readiness.
  
Conduct application technical\-health, strategic\-fit and portfolio\-rationalization assessments using frameworks such as TIME or equivalent.
  
Convert architecture gaps and recommendations into prioritized transformation initiatives and implementation work packages.
  
Develop high\-level project charters covering scope, outcomes, capabilities, architecture, dependencies, risks, effort and success measures.
  
Create phased technology roadmaps aligned with business value, process transformation, data foundations, change readiness and investment capacity.
  
Provide technology cost, benefit, dependency and risk inputs to business cases and value\-realization plans.
  
Define enterprise architecture, application, integration and data\-governance models, including decision rights and architecture\-assurance processes.
  
Facilitate workshops and present architecture options, trade\-offs and recommendations to executive and senior\-management stakeholders.
  
Provide technical direction and quality assurance to domain architects, solution architects, business analysts and platform specialists.
  
Support proposals, solution shaping, estimation, presales and development of architecture methods and reusable consulting assets.
  
  

Required Experience and Skills
  
  

8\+ or more years of experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, solution architecture or digital transformation.
  
Proven experience leading Phase 0, discovery, assessment, technology strategy, roadmap or pre\-implementation advisory engagements.
  
Strong understanding of business capabilities, value streams, end\-to\-end processes and Target Operating Model design.
  
Experience developing current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures.
  
Ability to integrate business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and security perspectives.
  
Experience with ERP, digital\-core or enterprise\-platform strategy involving solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion or comparable platforms.
  
Experience assessing and rationalizing complex application portfolios.
  
Experience defining strategic initiatives, project charters, transition architectures and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
  
Understanding of API, integration\-platform, event\-driven, data\-platform, analytics, master\-data and cloud\-architecture concepts.
  
Experience in one or more complex domains, such as process manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, energy, utilities, life sciences, consumer products, logistics or asset\-intensive industries.
  
Strong executive communication, consulting, workshop\-facilitation and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
Ability to explain complex architecture decisions as clear business choices, implications and recommendations.
  
Commercial awareness and experience supporting proposals, estimates, business cases or vendor evaluations.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline.
  
Postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, technology or management is advantageous.
  
TOGAF, ArchiMate, cloud, data, Microsoft, SAP, Oracle or comparable architecture certification is desirable.
  
Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, Orbus, MEGA or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
  
Experience with process\-manufacturing concepts such as batch genealogy, quality management, asset traceability and supply\-chain planning is advantageous.
  
Experience working across multiple countries, business units or acquisition\-led technology landscapes is preferred.
  
  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  
Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission\-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!



Amazon DynamoDB is a key\-value and document database that delivers single\-digit\-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast\-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission\-critical workloads.



We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.



As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission\-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub\-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world\-class systems \& software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day\-to\-day people and performance management tasks.



You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value\-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross\-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.



You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.



If you want to test your limits, build a world\-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!



About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
